quandoUsar: Demos or game areas with a play-money balance where several balls fall at the same time, each with its own bet.
Show a binomial distribution in action: the middle slots come up more often and pay less, the end ones are rare and pay more.
When the person chooses the risk (`low`, `medium`, `high`) and sees the multiplier table change instantly.
quandoEvitar: Do not use with real money or prizes: the balance is play money and each ball's path is drawn in the browser with `random`.
Use `crash-game` or `mines-game` when the person should decide during the round, cashing out before losing.
Use `slide-game` for one result per bet with the odds of each multiplier on display.

teclado.acao: On the “Drop a ball” button, drops a ball; repeating drops more, up to `maxBalls` falling together.
In the risk group, switches between “Low”, “Medium” and “High” (native radios); locked while balls are falling.
In the bet field, confirms the value and clamps it between `minBet` and the balance.
Moves through reset balance, bet, ½, 2×, Max, the selected risk and the drop button.

acessibilidade: The board is `aria-hidden`; the screen reader finds the list of slot multipliers, from left to right, and hears each landing (“Ball N landed on…”) in a `role="status"` region.
The risk is a group of native radios labeled “Risk”, each inside a `<label>`; the keyboard focus outline appears on the segment.
With several balls, each landing produces a new announcement; texts and announcements are fixed in English.
movimento: Each ball falls and, at each row, bounces left or right with a small upward impulse before gravity; the peg it touches lights up and grows.
The slot where the ball lands sinks and lights up, keeps a ring until the next drop, and the values swap with a slight slide when the risk changes.
With “reduce motion” on, no ball is drawn: the result comes out after a short pause and the slot only lights up, without sinking.
responsivo: The card goes up to 42rem and is a container: the board sits above the controls and moves to the side from 36rem, at most 27rem wide.
The board is an SVG that scales as a whole, and the slots follow its width; below 22rem the “×” disappears from the labels.
desempenho: A per-frame callback moves all the balls directly in the DOM, without rendering React on each step; `maxBalls` (8) limits how many fall together and `rows` ranges from 6 to 12.
notasIA: `risk` recomputes the table from each slot's binomial probability; for your own table, pass `multipliers` with exactly `rows + 1` values, otherwise it is ignored.
The bet leaves the balance when the ball is dropped and the payout comes in at landing, when `onDrop` arrives with slot, multiplier, bet and payout.
The bet field stays editable with balls falling and each ball keeps the bet from the moment it was dropped; it is play money, with its own copy of `play-money.tsx`.
